 Order

This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.637/2013 dated 24.12.2013, under Sections 498A/406 IPC, registered at PS Bindapur, New Delhi, on the ground that the parties have settled their disputes vide Memorandum of Understanding dated 19.02.2021 which is on record of this Court.
2. The petitioner Nos.1 - 4 and respondent No.2 (complainant) are present in Court and are duly identified by the respective counsels and the IO.
The respondent No.2 has stated that she has received all the amounts as per the settlement and nothing is further due.
The petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 were married on November 14th, 2011, however, due to the mutual differences, the marriage has resulted in a decree of divorce dated 08.11.2021.
There is one minor child who was born out of the wedlock.

3. Considering the above settlement between the parties and chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use to continue with proceedings of the present FIR as the complainant has settled all disputes with the petitioner.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No.637/2013 dated 24.12.2013, under Sections 498A/406 IPC, registered at PS Bindapur, New Delhi, and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
It is however made clear that the said settlement will not affect the rights of the minor child in future.
